organisation: US Federal Aviation Administration (Office of Aviation Policy and Plans)
dataset: Economic Values for FAA Investment and Regulatory Decisions, Section 4: Aircraft Operating Costs (2024 update), Tables 4-3, 4-6, 4-7, 4-16
licence: US Government work (public domain in the US)
cost_categories: crew; maintenance (airframe + engine, total); insurance; depreciation; rentals; fuel
used_in_repository: yes: three values (954 maintenance, 1378 crew, 6 insurance USD/block hour; US Part 121 passenger narrowbody >=165k lb MTOW, A320 class per Table 4-16) in data/scenarios/benchmark_faa_us_narrowbody_partial.json
limitations: US industry averages for passenger carriers; not European, not airline-specific, not freighter-specific (Table 4-6 lists all-cargo totals but not by narrowbody class). Maintenance is not split into airframe/engine/LLP. Depreciation and rentals are fleet blends of owned and leased aircraft and are deliberately NOT used for a single-aircraft ownership scenario. No inflation or currency-region adjustment is applied when used for 2025. Figures are kept exactly as published (YE June 2023 USD); inflation adjustment is deferred to Part 5 and would need a verified public index with documented original and target periods.
verification_status: values transcribed from the official PDF; table/row cited per value in the scenario file

dataset: Air Carrier Financial Reports (Form 41) Schedule P-5.2: aircraft operating expenses by aircraft type
units: thousands of USD per carrier/aircraft type/quarter; airborne hours (Z6500 TotalAirHours)
cost_categories: crew (PilotFlyOps); fuel; rentals; insurance (InsFlyOps); airframe and engine labour, materials and repairs; maintenance allowances; depreciation (AirframeDep, EngineDep)
used_in_repository: yes (Part 5): ingested 2024Q1-2026Q2 into benchmark_observation via scripts/ingest_bts_benchmarks.py (raw ZIP snapshots in git-ignored data/raw/bts/); 10 expense categories per carrier x type x configuration x region x quarter; real excerpts in tests/fixtures/bts/
limitations: Carrier-reported accounting expense, not economic cost; aircraft operating expense only (no ground, sales, G&A, interest); U.S. carriers; hours published to 0.01 thousand; fleet-level (type 999) rows excluded; see docs/bts_form41_methodology.md.
verification_status: fields, units and lookup tables verified on TranStats; join to T2 verified (airborne hours agree within max(10 h, 1%))

dataset: Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics: 53-2011 Airline Pilots, Copilots, and Flight Engineers (national, annual mean wage)
units: USD per year (annual mean wage; hourly wage not published for this occupation)
used_in_repository: no (registered only; series value 288,650 USD/year retrieved via the official API)
limitations: Wage only: excludes employer on-costs, allowances and productivity (allocable block hours). All US airline pilots across aircraft types and seniority; does not separate captain/first officer or cargo operators; not European.
verification_status: retrieved via the official BLS public API

dataset: Operating lease rental rates by aircraft type
limitations: Market lease-rate indices (e.g. appraiser and lessor publications) are subscription or paywalled; no reusable public source was found. Lease inputs must be user-supplied.

dataset: Hull and liability insurance premiums / rates for a single aircraft
limitations: Broker market reports are paywalled or qualitative; FAA per-block-hour fleet averages are the only reusable public figures found.

dataset: Current market / acquisition values by aircraft type and vintage
limitations: Manufacturer list prices are no longer published; appraiser values are paywalled. Acquisition, residual and loan inputs must be user-supplied.

dataset: Engine LLP and maintenance reserve rates
limitations: Reserve rates are lease-contract terms and not published; engine shop-visit costs are proprietary. LLP reserves must be user-supplied.

dataset: Air Carrier Summary Data T2: U.S. air carrier traffic and capacity statistics by aircraft type
units: hours (ramp-to-ramp, airborne), departures, statute miles, ton-miles (short ton x statute mile), gallons
licence: U.S. Government work (public domain); citation required
cost_categories: denominators for BTS benchmarks (block hours, departures, RTM, ATM)
used_in_repository: yes (Part 5): service class Z joined to P-5.2; ton-miles converted to tonne-NM (x 0.90718474 x 1609.344/1852)
limitations: Revenue ton-miles of passenger-configured aircraft include passengers; departures are revenue departures only.
verification_status: fields and service-class lookup verified on TranStats

dataset: Employment Cost Index CIU2014300000000I: total compensation, private industry, transportation and warehousing (NSA)
used_in_repository: yes (Part 5): price_index_observation; FAA crew 1378 -> 1491.46 USD/BH for 2025-01-15 (proxy_pending_owner_approval)
limitations: Industry-wide labour cost, not pilot-specific; quarterly point-in-time index treated as representative of its quarter.
verification_status: retrieved from the official BLS API; ID layout per bls.gov help; title per FRED mirror

dataset: PPI PCU524126524126: direct property and casualty insurers (NSA)
limitations: All property and casualty lines, not aviation-specific; recent values preliminary for four months.
verification_status: retrieved from the official BLS API

limitations: BLS API reported PCU488190488190 (Other support activities for air transportation) as non-existent on 2026-10-15; a single CPI is not used.
